title: UAPA conviction rate

source.name: NCRB Crime in India; Ministry of Home Affairs replies in Parliament

points.note: MHA reply covering 2016-2019 aggregate, not a single-year value.
Range of 1.5-4 per cent cited across NCRB volumes and the Supreme Court's May 2025 observations; midpoint recorded as approximate.

notes: Conviction rate is not a welfare measure and carries no directional reading in this instrument: a low rate is read by the government as due process functioning and by critics as evidence of misuse. Direction is deliberately unset.
